note: Knowledge checks are a reading check only. A pass on them is not verified practical competence.

knowledgeAnswers.rationale: A destructive method on historic finishes is refused without approval and suitability evidence.
Recording damage and testing or referring come before any method. Scrubbing or strong products are refused until then.

practicalCriteria: The learner rejects an untested destructive method.
The learner records pre-existing damage before work begins.
Learner completes the procedure record for the mock case and names the stop-work trigger before any practical step.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed mock decision record for the lesson case
Assessor observation of the simulated scenario, with no real site work or hazardous material
stopWorkCriteria: A destructive or abrasive method is proposed without a test.
Fragile or heritage finish is involved and no specialist is engaged.
